pages.text: Royal Cider can be made through mixing together Minced Crystalline Garlic, Elven Tea, and Almond Extract. Once put through a sequenced assembly in combination with Cream, you eventually get a Glass of Royal Cider!
The Glass of Royal Cider item can also be placed down as a decorative item while sneaking. While it just be instantly broken, you can also shift+right-click to pick it back up.
